evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: XGBoost wins decisively under cross-dataset distribution shift, by 15 points of F1 and 25 points of balanced accuracy; on the target network RoBERTa-LoRA's false positive rate reaches 0.78, leaving it barely above chance despite a superficially moderate F1.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: These results argue for evaluating NIDS models along multiple independent robustness axes, and with more than one metric per axis.
